entries.title: Bolt tightening torque (M10–M48, 8.8 / 10.9)
entries.principle: Torque T ≈ K × F × d with proof-stress preload (typically 0.9 × σp × As); K ≈ 0.14 oiled / 0.18 dry.
entries.standardValue: Use class 8.8 (580 MPa) or 10.9 (900 MPa) proof stress per ISO 898-1; shipyard tables for M10–M48.
actionSteps: Confirm bolt size, property class, and lubrication (oiled vs dry).
Apply torque in star pattern; re-check after first thermal cycle on hot joints.

entries.title: Crankshaft deflection (ΔV / ΔH, class limits)
entries.principle: Vertical and horizontal dial readings at each crank pin; misalignment shows as ΔV/ΔH pattern vs adjacent units.
entries.standardValue: Class rule limit often 0.05–0.15 mm (maker-specific); reject if trend worsens or exceeds manual limit.
actionSteps: Record all units at same crank angle; compare to baseline after bearing work.
If limit exceeded, check bearing clearance, chock slack, and hull deflection.

entries.title: Pmax / Pcomp balance & after-burning
entries.principle: Cylinder peak (Pmax) and compression (Pcomp) pressures indicate timing, injection, and ring sealing health.
entries.standardValue: Typical balance tolerance ±3.0 bar between units (maker-dependent); persistent high Texh suggests after-burning.
actionSteps: Compare cards across units at same load; investigate outliers first.
Check fuel pump timing, injector condition, and scavenge air if after-burning suspected.

entries.title: Cylinder oil feed rate & BN matching
entries.principle: Base Number (BN) must match fuel sulphur; feed rate balances liner wear vs deposit control.
entries.standardValue: Match BN to fuel S% per maker chart; adjust feed if iron or soot trends rise.
actionSteps: Enter fuel sulphur and engine parameters in the cylinder lube optimizer.
Cross-check with scrape-down analysis and port condition.

entries.title: PT100 resistance to temperature (IEC 60751)
entries.principle: Callendar–Van Dusen: R(T) for industrial PT100 with R0 = 100 Ω at 0°C.
entries.standardValue: 100.0 Ω at 0°C; ~138.5 Ω at 100°C (Class B tolerance per IEC 60751).
actionSteps: Measure resistance at known ambient; invert to temperature for alarm setpoint checks.
Verify lead resistance compensation on 3-wire RTD circuits.

entries.title: 3-phase motor FLC & EOCR trip range
entries.principle: Full-load current from kW, voltage, efficiency, and power factor; EOCR set just above FLC.
entries.standardValue: Trip class 10–20 typical; instantaneous short-circuit via breaker; EOCR ≈ 105–115% FLC adjustable.
actionSteps: Calculate FLC from nameplate or kW rating.
Set EOCR pickup and time delay per maker curve; prove with ammeter at rated load.

entries.title: Refrigerant saturation & superheat
entries.principle: Superheat = suction line temp minus saturation temp at suction pressure; subcooling on liquid line.
entries.standardValue: Typical stable superheat 4–8°C at evaporator outlet (system-dependent).
actionSteps: Log suction/discharge pressures and line temperatures.
Adjust expansion valve or charge if superheat out of band.

entries.title: Boiler water treatment (pH, chloride, blowdown)
entries.principle: Alkaline phosphate treatment controls scale; chloride indicates contamination or insufficient blowdown.
entries.standardValue: pH 9.5–11; chloride Cl⁻ < 300 ppm (low-pressure guidelines); blowdown when Cl⁻ or TDS high.
actionSteps: Test pH, chloride, and phosphate; increase blowdown if Cl⁻ critical.
Dose treatment chemicals per analysis; record in engine log.

entries.title: Tokyo/Paris MoU — Emergency fire pump
entries.principle: Emergency fire pump must start independently and deliver pressure at remotest hydrant.
entries.standardValue: SOLAS II-2 / FSS Code: independent power, priming, and pressure at remotest hydrant per class.
actionSteps: Run emergency fire pump drill; log pressure and starting source.
Verify priming tank, relief, and remote start from muster stations.

entries.title: OWS 15 ppm alarm & fail-safe
entries.principle: 15 ppm monitor must alarm and stop overboard discharge automatically (fail-safe to tank).
entries.standardValue: MARPOL Annex I Reg. 14: 15 ppm alarm, automatic stopping device, and 15 ppm overboard interlock records.
actionSteps: Demonstrate alarm at 15 ppm test; verify 3-way valve returns to sludge tank.
Keep calibration and zero-check records for PSC.

entries.title: Quick-closing valve pneumatic release
entries.principle: Fuel and lube oil quick-closing valves close from safe remote position on pneumatic or wire release.
entries.standardValue: FSS Code Ch. 4: remote operation from safe position; marking and periodic function test.
actionSteps: Test pneumatic release from fire control station or local safe point.
Confirm valve labels and crew familiarization for CIC.

entries.title: IBC Code — SUS316L passivation vs phenolic epoxy tanks
entries.principle: Stainless passivation suits oxidizing cargoes; phenolic/epoxy linings required for aggressive or chlorinated solvents per IBC product list.
entries.standardValue: IBC Ch. 15 & product list: verify tank material/certificate vs cargo; no interchange without coating compatibility approval.
actionSteps: Check IBC certificate and cargo compatibility table before loading.
Inspect coating holiday test records; use paint/tank coating cross-reference for repairs.

entries.title: Bunker quantity — ASTM Table 54B VCF
entries.principle: Volume correction to 15°C and mass in air using ASTM D1250 / Table 54B methodology.
entries.standardValue: Report MT in air with documented ρ15 and observed temperature.
actionSteps: Enter volume, density @15°C, and temperature in bunker calculator.
Archive sounding and lab density for dispute resolution.

entries.title: Flange matrix — JIS / ANSI / DIN
entries.principle: Match OD, PCD, bolt circle, and bolt size when replacing gaskets or spools.
entries.standardValue: Use standard tables (JIS 5K/10K/16K, ANSI 150#, DIN PN10) — no mixing across ratings.
actionSteps: Filter flange table by standard and nominal bore.
Verify pressure rating and gasket type before breakout.
